2610.11314.title: From Retrieval to Reconstruction: Constructing Evolvable Cognitive Memory for Long-Term Dialogue
2610.11314.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) serving as long-term dialogue agents require memory systems that support reliable reasoning over extended interactions. However, existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks typically treat memory as passive storage, making it difficult to distinguish source-attributed beliefs from unattributed event/fact records and to connect evidence dispersed across sessions. We introduce CogMem, a cognitive memory architecture based on the PEC$^2$F (Person-Event-Concept-Claim-Fact) graph schema. Dedicated Claim nodes preserve the source and target of subjective statements, while Fact and Event nodes represent semantic and episodic knowledge. Dialogue turns are incrementally converted into provenance-aware graph records, consolidated into higher-level facts, and reconciled into temporally scoped Claim views when the same source provides conflicting updates. For retrieval, a rule-based controller driven by LLM intent parsing composes four deterministic graph operators---anchoring, traversal, intersection, and evidence grounding---to reconstruct query-relevant context. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show strong performance, especially on multi-hop, temporal, and knowledge-update tasks. Ablations and a semantic-collapse probe support complementary contributions from epistemic separation, consolidation, and agentic retrieval. Code: https://github.com/Silent-Rain02/CogMem.
2610.11314.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）作為長期對話代理需要支持可靠推理的記憶系統，以便在延長的互動中使用。然後，現有的檢索增強生成（RAG）框架通常將記憶視為被動存儲，這使得區分來源所屬的信念與未歸屬的事件/事實記錄變得困難，並且難以連接分散在多個會話中的證據。我們介紹了CogMem，一種基於PEC$^2$F（人-事件-概念-主張-事實）圖形架構的認知記憶架構。專用的主張節點保留主觀陳述的來源和目標，而事實和事件節點則表示語義和情節知識。對話回合逐步轉換為考慮來源的圖形記錄，整合為更高層次的事實，並在同一來源提供相互矛盾的更新時，調和為時間範圍的主張視圖。為了檢索，基於LLM意圖解析的基於規則的控制器組合了四個確定性圖形運算符——錨定、遍歷、交集和證據基礎——以重建與查詢相關的上下文。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的實驗顯示出強大的性能，特別是在多跳、時間和知識更新任務上。消融實驗和語義崩潰探針支持來自認識分離、整合和代理檢索的互補貢獻。代碼：https://github.com/Silent-Rain02/CogMem。
